facts.fact: The Bank of Mozambique's communiqué of 30 July 2026 says Metix integrates banks, microbanks, electronic money institutions and other payment service providers authorised by the central bank.
Bank of Mozambique launched the Metix instant payment system on 16 March 2026, run by SIMO, and reports its volume (over 11,000 transfers a day) in its Monetary Policy Committee communiqué.

MOZ.note: No government payments to people stated.
Account and wallet counts only, no survey share of adults.

facts.fact: Mozambique had more than 25 million digital mobile wallet accounts at the start of 2026 and three electronic money institutions, M-Pesa, e-Mola and M-Kesh, owned by the three mobile operators.
The Bank of Mozambique attributes growth partly to interoperability between electronic money institutions, banks, microbanks and other payment service providers through SIMOrede.

Metix, in production since March 2026 and run by SIMO, integrates banks, microbanks and electronic money institutions, with participation by digital wallet operators mandatory, and processes over 11,000 transfers a day.
